summary: The ChangePassword feature provides a web interface for users to change their passwords within the HSPnet application. It includes form elements for current and new password inputs, validation controls to ensure strong password criteria are met, and processes to display errors or success messages.
purpose: The purpose of the ChangePassword feature is to allow users to securely update their password while ensuring compliance with security policies such as length and complexity requirements.

workflows.name: Change Password Process
steps: User navigates to Change Password page.
User enters current password in 'txtCurrentPassword' input.
User enters new password in 'txtNewPassword' input.
User re-enters new password in 'txtNewPassword2' input.
System validates inputs according to defined rules.
If all validations pass, the system updates the password.
If validations fail, system displays appropriate error messages.

business_rules: New password must be a combination of letters and digits.
New password must contain upper and lower case letters.
New password must contain at least one symbol.
New password must be at least 12 characters long.
New password must differ from the current password.
User must agree to the policies by checking the policy acceptance checkbox.
validations: Ensure 'txtNewPassword' meets complexity and length requirements.
system_behavior: Displays password strength indicator when user inputs new password.
Automatically registers JavaScript for client-side validations.
Redirects user to Tools page upon successful password change.
Displays validation summary in case of errors.
dependencies: User session must be active and correctly initialized.
Resource strings for error and information messages.
exceptions: Validation errors if password criteria are not met.
User session errors leading to process interruption.
